context: The Active Prompt page in the Web UI currently takes up significant vertical space, making it difficult to view all elements on a 14-inch screen without scrolling. This questionnaire helps decide the best approach for making the page more compact while preserving all functionality and improving the user experience. The key areas requiring attention are: prompt title/header, action buttons (Create New Prompt, Add Modification, Complete Prompt), Execution Mode selector, Progress Status indicators, and overall layout optimization.

questions.question-text: How should the three main action buttons (Create New Prompt, Add Modification, Complete Prompt) be organized?

options.label: Keep them in a single horizontal row with reduced padding and smaller size
options.pros: Simple change, maintains current layout pattern, easy to scan left-to-right
options.cons: May still take up too much horizontal space on narrow screens, less flexible for future button additions

options.label: Move them to a sticky header toolbar that remains visible while scrolling
options.pros: Always accessible, makes efficient use of space, clear separation from content, modern UX pattern
options.cons: Requires more significant HTML/CSS changes, reduces vertical space for content initially

options.label: Group them in a dropdown 'Actions' menu
options.pros: Maximum space savings, clean interface, scalable for adding more actions
options.cons: Requires extra click to access buttons, less discoverable, may slow down common operations

options.label: Use icon-only buttons with tooltips in a compact button group
options.pros: Very space-efficient, modern appearance, works well on small screens
options.cons: Less immediately clear what each button does, relies on icon recognition and tooltips

questions.recommendation-rationale: A sticky toolbar approach provides the best balance between space efficiency and usability. It keeps the most important actions always accessible while scrolling through long prompt content, and it establishes a clear visual hierarchy. This is a common pattern in modern web applications and would significantly improve the experience on 14-inch screens without sacrificing discoverability.

questions.question-text: How should the Execution Mode selector be made more compact while maintaining its functionality?

options.label: Convert to a dropdown select menu
options.pros: Takes up minimal space, familiar UI pattern, easy to implement, clear current selection
options.cons: Requires click to see all options, less visual indication of available modes

options.label: Use smaller buttons with icon-only display (icons from current implementation)
options.pros: More compact than current, still shows all options at once, maintains quick access
options.cons: May be harder to understand for new users, relies on icon/color recognition

options.label: Keep current button group but reduce padding, margins, and font size
options.pros: Minimal code changes, maintains familiarity, all options visible
options.cons: May not save enough space, could reduce readability if made too small

options.label: Move to a horizontal compact toggle with current mode displayed prominently and others in a collapsed menu
options.pros: Shows active mode clearly, saves space, modern pattern
options.cons: More complex interaction pattern, requires redesign of the component

questions.recommendation-rationale: A dropdown select menu is the most space-efficient solution and is a standard UI pattern that users understand. Since execution mode is not changed frequently during normal workflow, the extra click to open the dropdown is acceptable. It would reduce the component from taking up a full row to just a small select control, saving significant vertical space.

questions.question-text: How should the Progress Status section (Questionnaire, Plan, Implementation indicators) be made more compact?

options.label: Display as a single horizontal compact status bar with icons and colored indicators
options.pros: Very space-efficient, quick visual scan, modern appearance, can show all statuses at once
options.cons: May be less detailed, requires good icon and color choice for clarity

options.label: Convert to a small badge group showing only active/completed statuses
options.pros: Minimal space usage, focuses on what matters, clean look
options.cons: May hide information, less comprehensive view of progress

options.label: Keep three columns but reduce icon size, padding, and use smaller badges
options.pros: Maintains current information structure, familiar layout, straightforward to implement
options.cons: May not save enough space, still uses three columns

options.label: Show as a compact progress indicator (e.g., '2/3 complete') with detailed view on hover/click
options.pros: Extremely compact, summarizes progress clearly, details available when needed
options.cons: Less immediate visibility of individual component statuses, requires interaction for details

questions.recommendation-rationale: A horizontal status bar with icons and colored indicators provides the best balance of compactness and information visibility. It can show all three status indicators in a single line rather than across three columns, saving significant vertical space while maintaining at-a-glance readability through color coding and icons.

questions.question-text: How should the prompt title/name be displayed more compactly in the card header?

options.label: Reduce header padding and font size while keeping the same structure
options.pros: Simple change, maintains readability, familiar layout
options.cons: Limited space savings, may look cramped if reduced too much

options.label: Move prompt ID and title to same line with smaller, lighter styling
options.pros: Consolidates information, saves vertical space, can fit in sticky toolbar
options.cons: May be less prominent, needs careful styling to remain readable

options.label: Show only prompt ID in header with full title on hover tooltip
options.pros: Maximum space savings, very compact
options.cons: Reduces immediate visibility of prompt context, requires hovering to see full title

options.label: Eliminate the large card header and integrate prompt info into the toolbar/controls area
options.pros: Significant space savings, modern flat design, better use of horizontal space
options.cons: Requires more significant layout restructuring

questions.recommendation-rationale: Integrating the prompt info into a toolbar/controls area (potentially the sticky toolbar from Q1) would provide the most space savings and create a more modern, efficient layout. The large card header with background color takes up significant space for information that could be displayed more compactly inline with other controls.

questions.question-text: Which elements should remain visible (sticky) while scrolling through the prompt content?

options.label: Only the main navigation bar at the top
options.pros: Standard behavior, maximum content space, no complexity
options.cons: Lose access to action buttons and controls when scrolling, requires scrolling back up

options.label: Main navigation + a compact toolbar with action buttons and prompt info
options.pros: Keeps most important controls accessible, good balance, aligns with Q1 and Q4 recommendations
options.cons: Uses some vertical space, requires implementing sticky positioning

options.label: Main navigation + toolbar + execution mode and status indicators
options.pros: Everything accessible while scrolling, maximum convenience
options.cons: Takes up significant fixed vertical space, reduces content viewing area

options.label: No sticky elements except navigation (let user scroll freely)
options.pros: Maximum content space, simple implementation
options.cons: Poor UX for long prompts, need to scroll to access controls

questions.recommendation-rationale: Making a compact toolbar sticky (in addition to the navigation) strikes the best balance. Users can access critical actions and see the prompt context without scrolling, while still having plenty of room for content. This is especially important on 14-inch screens where vertical space is limited. The execution mode and status can be accessed by scrolling up slightly if needed, but the most common actions should remain accessible.

questions.question-text: Should the Execution Mode and Progress Status sections be combined into a single more compact control area?

options.label: Yes, combine them into a single horizontal toolbar/bar
options.pros: Significant space savings, reduces visual clutter, groups related information, modern layout
options.cons: Requires careful design to avoid cramming too much in one line, may need responsive breakpoints

options.label: No, keep them as separate sections but make each more compact
options.pros: Clearer separation of concerns, easier to understand, less risky change
options.cons: Won't save as much space, still uses vertical space for two separate sections

options.label: Combine them in a collapsible panel that can be toggled
options.pros: Maximum space savings when collapsed, full detail when expanded, user control
options.cons: Adds interaction complexity, may hide important information by default

questions.recommendation-rationale: Combining these two sections into a single compact toolbar makes logical sense since both relate to the current state and mode of the prompt. Together with converting the execution mode to a dropdown and the progress status to a horizontal bar (from Q2 and Q3), they could fit in a single well-organized row, saving significant vertical space without losing functionality.
